eval_hotpotqa_predictions: eval HotpotQA predictions against gold answers and supporting facts from JSON files
test_f1_score: test the f1_score function to compute F1, precision, and recall between a prediction and ground truth answer
test_exact_match_score: test the exact_match_score function to check if a prediction exactly matches the ground truth answer
test_update_sp: test the update_sp function to compute EM, precision, recall for supporting fact prediction evaluation
test_normalize_answer: test the normalize_answer function to strip articles, punctuation, whitespace, and lowercase text
